subject: Re: Status: benchmark repro + June critical path
body:
Team — decisions for Friday's readout.

The June matrices came in on schedule and the story is clean: transfer works where structure is similar — on the session-graph domain, transferred models reach within a few points of per-domain training, good enough to kill cold-start training there — while the entity-graph domain shows the gap the benchmark warned about, so per-domain training stays.

Recommendation: a hybrid. Transfer-based TLP becomes the default for structurally similar onboarding domains, with a documented similarity check (Ondrej's criterion) deciding which path a new domain takes.

Bilal's sharded loader held up at full scale — worth writing up separately. Scope note: we are not proposing hub-style pretraining across all domains this year; that's a Q4 conversation with Eleni's org.

Readout deck reviews Thursday.

Anders
